reference_title: UFC 4-023-03, Design of Buildings to Resist Progressive Collapse (DoD, dated 14 July 2009, as amended through Change 4, 10 June 2024)
scope_note: Full-manual coverage (243 pages). Chapters 1-8 body text extracted (chapter01.json through chapter08.json). Chapter 3 (Design Procedures) is the largest chapter and its equations are split across three Python modules by major section: tie_forces.py (Section 3-1), alternate_path.py (Section 3-2), enhanced_local_resistance.py (Section 3-3) -- equation_module below names the primary module (tie_forces) for that chapter entry. Appendix A (references), Appendix B (definitions, narrative), and Appendix C (commentary, narrative) are NOT extracted as chapter text -- Appendix C's Table C-1 and Figure C-7 fit ARE digitized directly in structural_steel.py/alternate_path.py. Appendix D (reinforced-concrete worked example) is used as a validation anchor in tie_forces.py/enhanced_local_resistance.py tests, not re-narrated as chapter text. Appendices E, F, G (steel/wood/cold-formed-steel worked examples) and Appendix H (IBC modifications) are likewise not re-narrated as chapter text; Appendix H's enumerable criteria are digitized in ibc_modifications.py. The figure catalog covers all 14 Chapter 3 figures, all 8 Appendix B figures, all 13 Appendix C figures, and all 4 Appendix D figures (39 total, all page-confirmed).
